role: targeted elemental strike for 雷 skills
dominant_shape: a jagged vertical bolt from the sky to the target, struck whole and re-struck mirrored

beats.name: sky charge
beats.expect: A small glow gathers above the target and a faint ring marks the ground

beats.name: strike
beats.expect: The whole bolt appears on one frame with the brightest white flash of the effect

beats.name: return stroke
beats.expect: A second, mirrored bolt on a different path replaces the first

beats.name: ground arcs
beats.expect: Bolts gone from the sky; small arcs crawl outward along the floor over glowing cracks

beats.name: after-flicker
beats.expect: One thin late flicker of the bolt, dimmer than the strike

beats.name: tail
beats.expect: Sparks landed, cracks cooling to blue, ozone smoke rising

beats.name: clear
beats.expect: Only faint smoke and scorch remain, fading out

layer_plan.name: 0:Sky charge
layer_plan.exit: fades in, gone at the strike (f6)

layer_plan.name: 27:Return stroke arc 1a
layer_plan.role: second strike on a different path

layer_plan.name: 68:Hot cracks
layer_plan.role: ground footprint glow cooling to blue

layer_plan.name: 93:Ozone smoke
layer_plan.exit: drifts up and fades by f60

acceptance: The bolt reads as one jagged line from above the frame to the target on the strike frame
Main strike, return stroke and after-flicker are on clearly different frames and paths
The strike frame is the brightest frame; nothing later is brighter
Final third shows only cooling cracks, landed sparks and rising smoke
avoid: A bolt that slides or travels down like a projectile
A recoloured fire or ice impact (round blast, rising flames, crystals)
A persistent white blob over the target after the strike
